purpose: Grok-B1 R16 demand: does a real cosmological dipole at A=1.7% (the binomial-null-inferred amplitude) survive the BOOTSTRAP null? This is the rigorous test of whether bootstrap-null verdict rules out interpretation (i).

verdict.if_median_bootstrap_gtr_3: real 1.7% dipole DOES survive bootstrap → 'interp (i) ruled out by bootstrap' is incorrect
verdict.if_median_bootstrap_LT_1: bootstrap is too wide for 1.7% detection → can't use bootstrap as (i) rejector
verdict.if_median_bootstrap_1_to_3: intermediate — bootstrap softens a real dipole's significance by ~3x; the data's σ=-0.22 may indicate either no dipole or substantial sensitivity loss
